body.name: Whole-class moment-projection interval
body.construction: Let \(\widehat q\) and \(\widehat\omega_j^2\) be the sample mean and coordinate variances of \(Z\) on \(D_2\), and set \(C=\{\vartheta\in\Theta:|Q_j(\vartheta)-\widehat q_j|\le z_{1-\alpha/(2d_p)}\widehat\omega_j/\sqrt{n_2}\text{ for }j=1,\ldots,d_p\}\). If \(C\ne\varnothing\), set \(J_S=[\inf_{\vartheta\in C}b_S(\vartheta),\sup_{\vartheta\in C}b_S(\vartheta)]\); if \(C=\varnothing\), set \(J_S=[\min_{\vartheta\in\Theta}b_S(\vartheta),\max_{\vartheta\in\Theta}b_S(\vartheta)]\).
